A concise collection of lessons and fabrication tools lets you choose a module to start or continue your work. The path begins with Culture and Land-Based Learning, then moves through the N.I.C.E. Design Process, logo design, accessible communication, and laser tools; CNC machining and 3D printing are planned next.
